horizon.friends.title: La ciyaar asxaabta
horizon.friends.hint: Asxaabtu waxay dhejiyaan koodka ka dib badhanka asxaabta ee shaashadda ciwaanka, xidhiidhka tooska ah, ama bogga bilawga ciyaarta.
horizon.friends.share_intro: La wadaag aduunkan gadaasha summada martiqaadka: waxay u furan tahay LAN, saaxiibada intarneedka ku jirana waxay ku biiraan koodka. Ma jiro server naga mid ah oo ku lug leh.
horizon.friends.short_code_changed: Qof ayaa sii waday inuu isku dayo kood gaaban oo khaldan, sidaa darteed wuu beddelay.
horizon.friends.wrong_code: Qof ayaa isku dayay kood qaldan
horizon.friends.relay_stopped: Koodhadhka gaaban ee khaldan ayaa aad u badan, sidaas darteed gudbinta waa damin ilaa aad mar kale wadaagto. Saaxiibadu wali waxay ku biiri karaan koodhka buuxa.
horizon.friends.code_ready: Koodhka martiqaadkaagu waa diyaar: Menu Game, La ciyaar asxaabta. Koobiyi una dir asxaabtaada.
horizon.friends.finding_route: Helitaanka sida saaxiibadu ku heli karaan…
horizon.multiplayer.connected_friend_dir: Si toos ah ugu xidhan saaxiibkaa...
horizon.multiplayer.connected_friend_rel: Ku xidhan saaxiibkaa iyada oo loo marayo gudbinta
